page.heading: Request Lines

form.descriptionPlaceholder: e.g. 50 user licenses for new project
form.descriptionInfo: Short description of what is needed.
form.productInfo: Optional catalog product. Leave blank for bespoke items.
form.lineTypeInfo: Whether the line covers goods, a service, or an expense.
form.quantityInfo: Number of units. Use 1 for flat-fee lines.
form.estimatedUnitPriceInfo: Estimated price per unit. Approver may revise during review.
form.estimatedTotalPriceInfo: Total estimated for this line. Auto-calculated as quantity × unit price.
form.supplierContractLineInfo: Optionally pre-link to an existing contract line if this item is already covered.
form.expenseAccountInfo: GL account override for this line.
form.locationInfo: Receiving location for this line, if different from the request location.

confirm.deleteMessage: Are you sure you want to remove this line? This action cannot be undone.
